name: ragmir
description: Cited local retrieval for Codex: search a project's code, specs, PDFs, and Office files and get passages cited to lines, pages, slides, or cells.

interface.longDescription: Ragmir indexes your project's code, specifications, PDFs, and Office files on your machine and returns passages cited to lines, PDF pages, slides, or spreadsheet cells. Searches return nothing when the sources hold no evidence.
